column1: # retired-names.tsv — the estate's registry of renamed shared objects.
# A rename is not finished when the object is renamed. It is finished when every
# front door either says the new name or admits it is saying the old one. This file
# is what remembers that, so a human eyeball is not the only detector.
#   1 retired_regex  ERE matching the dead name as it appears in prose
#   2 current_name   what to call it now (printed in the failure message)
#   3 retired_on     ISO date of the rename
#   4 ack_regex      ERE that, present ANYWHERE in the file, means "this doc knows"
# Adding a rename = append one row. That is the whole procedure.
